# Pauhu Database Client

> Client for reading records from a granted local database without modifying it; plans and receipts come from the Pauhu demo backend. Reading is free; backend access requires a free Pauhu developer key.

- [Developer key](https://pauhu.dev/developer-terms/): free, 90 days, 50 requests a day, at most 5 a minute
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions for AI agents
- [server.json](server.json): MCP remote server
- [Skill](skills/pauhu-developer-key/SKILL.md)
